items.name: Duskfield Grenade
items.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷会在撞击时碎裂，留下一片减速目标的力场，未离开力场范围的敌人会被冻结。

items.name: Glacier Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷可制造出冰影水晶所形成的墙壁以阻挡伤害和冻结目标；可以碎裂这些墙壁来制造伤害。

items.name: Shatter Grenade
items.description: A grenade that sticks to combatants before exploding into razor-sharp [Stasis] Stasis shrapnel. The shrapnel ricochets off surfaces, dealing damage to all in its path. Hitting a frozen target shatters it instantly and deals bonus damage.
items.descriptionZh: 一种会粘附在战斗人员身上，然后爆炸成锋利冰影弹片的手雷。弹片会在表面弹射，对路径上的一切造成伤害。命中被冻结的目标会立即将其击碎并造成额外伤害。

items.name: Coldsnap Grenade
items.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷命中后会冻结敌人并释放另一颗跟踪雷来寻找并冻结目标。

perkDetails.name: Touch of Flame
perkDetails.description:
Your Healing, Solar, Firebolt, and Fusion Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Healing Grenade: Improves the strength of cure and restoration effects applied. Consuming a Healing Grenade with Heat Rises also applies restoration to nearby allies.

Solar Grenade: Increases linger duration. Periodically emits blobs of lava around its perimeter.

Firebolt Grenade: Increases target search radius and maximum target count.

Fusion Grenade: Explodes twice.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的治愈、烈日、烈焰和融合手雷功能增强。

治愈手雷：提高所施加的治愈和恢复效果的强度。 炙热升腾时消耗治愈手雷还会对附近的盟友提供恢复效果。

烈日手雷：提升持续时间。在其周围周期性地发射熔岩团块。

烈焰手雷：提升目标搜寻范围和最大目标数。

融合手雷：可爆炸两次。

perkDetails.name: On the Prowl
perkDetails.description:
Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team. Entering invisibility immediately marks a target.

Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it. 

When priority targets are defeated, you and nearby allies gain increased weapon reload speed and stability for a short duration and are granted grenade, melee, and class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
周期性将附近的一名战斗人员标记为你和你队伍的首要目标。进入隐形状态会立即标记一个目标。

击败首要目标会生成具有削弱效果的烟雾云，你和盟友穿过它时会获得隐身状态。

当首要目标被击败时，你和附近的盟友会在短时间内提升武器填装速度和稳定性，并获得手雷、近战和职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Mindspun Invocation
perkDetails.description:
Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的抓取、束缚手雷、线虫手雷和切线手雷拥有强化性能。

你的抓取近战会生成三个线虫。

[手雷]  ：按住消耗你的束缚手雷并激活编织者之境。编织者之境激活时造成最后一击可生成一次悬停爆炸。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的线虫手雷，使其在命中地点编织一个不断生成线虫的线虫巢穴。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的切线手雷。该手雷最终爆炸时将发射子弹药并在其路径上留下一个缠结。

perkDetails.name: Weakened Clear
perkDetails.description: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Retinal Burn
perkDetails.description: Rapid [Arc] Arc weapon precision hits consume an Armor Charge to trigger a blinding burst at the target's location.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速电弧武器精准命中会消耗一层护甲充能，在目标位置触发一次致盲爆发。

perkDetails.name: Curative Orbs
perkDetails.description:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你首次击破目标的护盾，或击破使用超能的守护者的护盾时，会生成一个能量球。

收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会为你提供少量生命值。

perkDetails.name: Void Renewal
perkDetails.description:
While Devour is active, [Void] Void weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Void Breach.

Picking up a Void Breach increases weapon reload and handling; Shotguns and Grenade Launchers are also reloaded from reserves.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
吞食生效时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空裂口。

拾取虚空裂口可提升武器填装和操控性；霰弹枪和榴弹发射器也会从备弹中填装。

perkDetails.name: Frost Renewal
perkDetails.description: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Hail The Storm
perkDetails.description:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perkDetails.name: Debilitating Wave
perkDetails.description:
Finishers emit a damaging wave that matches the element of your currently equipped Super.

Arc, Void, and Stasis waves apply Blind, Weaken, and Slow respectively.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
终结技会释放一道与当前已装备超能元素相匹配的伤害波。

电弧、虚空和冰影伤害波分别施加致盲、削弱和减速。

items.name: Suppression
items.description:
The target is taken out of any active abilities and cannot activate any abilities or movement modes while suppression persists. Afflicted combatants cannot fire their weapons.

When suppressed, [Disruption] Overload Champions are stunned.

被压制时，过载勇士会眩晕。

perkDetails.name: Overload Hand Cannon
perkDetails.description:
Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用任意手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Anti-barrier Submachine Gun
perkDetails.description:
Submachine Guns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Submachine Guns are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你使用的微型冲锋枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle

perkDetails.descriptionZh:

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perkDetails.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when this modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用装备的自动步枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Sidearm

Aiming down the sights of a Sidearm for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:

此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Glaive
perkDetails.description: Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Glaives are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的偃月可发射一枚强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间偃月将始终过充。

perkDetails.name: Overload Trace Rifles
perkDetails.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perkDetails.name: Overload Scout Rifle
perkDetails.description: Landing consecutive hits on combatants with any Scout Rifle you are wielding causes disruption, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering their damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用任意斥候步枪连续命中战斗人员可造成混乱效果，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perkDetails.description: Aiming down the sights of a Hand Cannon for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 手炮举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

perkDetails.name: Anti-Barrier Auto Rifle
perkDetails.description: Your equipped Auto Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的自动步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

items.name: Phantom Surge
items.description:
Dash forward, slashing combatants as you pass through them. Deals significantly increased damage to Void-debuffed targets, or targets marked by On The Prowl.
 
Generate Void Overshield for each combatant hit. Defeating at least one combatant grants additional Overshield and refunds melee ability energy.
items.descriptionZh:
向前冲刺，穿过战斗人员时对其猛击。对受到虚空减益的目标或被伺机而动标记的目标造成显著提升的伤害。
 
每命中一名战斗人员都会生成虚空覆盖护盾。击败至少一名战斗人员提供额外覆盖护盾并返还近战技能能量。

tooltipNotifications.displayString:

This ability can be unlocked by speaking with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.

Ability requires meditation.

Use the meditation device near Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar to unlock.

items.name: Snare Bomb
items.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
items.descriptionZh:
投掷一个烟雾弹，它会附着在表面上，发信号给敌人的雷达，然后引爆为一团使人迷失方向的烟云，削弱附近的目标。烟云内的目标会受到持续伤害。

部署后，让附近的盟友隐身。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
items.descriptionZh:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Consecration
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可向前发射一波烈日能量，跃向空中的同时对前方目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战技能可猛击地面，生成第二波更大的烈日伤害能量。如果能量波击中灼烧目标，则会将其点燃。

perkDetails.name: Unbreakable
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

perkDetails.name: Knockout
perkDetails.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

perkDetails.name: Drengr's Lash
perkDetails.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Drengr's Lash

Defeating weakened targets with a [Void] Void weapon applies Volatile to nearby targets.
Powerful targets increase the radius of the explosion.

使用虚空武器击败被削弱的目标会对附近目标施加不稳定。
强力目标增加爆炸半径。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: Exhaust is applied by [Disruption] disrupting combatants or by weapons with the Psychohack or Subjugation Origin Traits.

使用与超能元素匹配的武器击败疲惫或割裂的目标会获得超能能量。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
items.descriptionZh:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施放超能时，你的火力战队中与你的超能类型不同的每位成员可获得武器伤害加成。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Argent Blade
perkDetails.description: While you have Armor Charge, dealing damage with a Sword consumes an Armor Charge and empowers your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and energy charge rate.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你有护甲充能时，使用刀剑造成伤害会消耗护甲充能，并在短时间内为你的刀剑赋能，使其获得额外伤害和充能速度。

perkDetails.name: Expanding Abyss
perkDetails.description: Void sources deal increased damage to weakened targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 虚空来源对被削弱目标造成的伤害增加。

perkDetails.name: Shieldcrush
perkDetails.description:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void Overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are amplified or radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的 近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的 手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

perkDetails.name: Transference
perkDetails.description:
Gain increased grenade and melee damage while transcendent.

Weapon final blows while transcendent refund Light and Dark energy after Transcendence ends.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
处于超凡状态时，可获得更高的手雷和 近战伤害。

处于超凡状态时，武器最后一击在超凡结束后可返还光能和暗影能量。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Sniper's Meditation
perkDetails.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perkDetails.name: Shock and Awe
perkDetails.description: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业的情况下，处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

perkDetails.description:
While you have an Overshield or are inside Ward of Dawn, final blows grant grenade and melee energy, you have increased melee range and damage, and melee final blows restore a small portion of your Overshield and extend its duration.

perkDetails.name: Unbreakable
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

perkDetails.name: Touch of Thunder
perkDetails.description:
Your Flashbang, Pulse, Lightning, and Storm Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Flashbang Grenade: Emits an additional blinding detonation on bounce.

Pulse Grenade: Creates Ionic Traces periodically as it damages targets and increases in damage over time.

Lightning Grenade: Grants an additional grenade charge, jolts targets hit by the initial blast, and grants Bolt Charge when it causes damage.

Storm Grenade: After detonating, creates a roaming thundercloud that tracks nearby targets and fires bolts of lightning at foes beneath it.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的闪光、脉冲、闪电以及风暴手雷有更强的效果。

闪光手雷：反弹时额外发射一次致盲爆炸。

脉冲手雷：对目标造成伤害时周期性产生离子轨迹并逐渐提高伤害。

闪电手雷：赋予一枚额外的手雷并震颤初次爆破命中的目标，并且在造成伤害时提供电光充能。

风暴手雷：在爆炸后，制造一团会追踪附近目标并朝下方敌人释放闪电的移动雷云。

perkDetails.name: Juggernaut
perkDetails.description:
With full class ability energy and after sprinting for a short time, you gain a frontal shield that blocks incoming damage. When the frontal shield breaks, your class ability energy is depleted. When the frontal shield takes damage, you gain a stack of Bolt Charge.

While amplified, the shield blocks significantly more damage before breaking.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在职业技能能量已满并短时间冲刺后，你会得到一面抵挡来袭伤害的正面护盾。在护盾被打破后，你会耗尽所有职业技能能量。当正面护盾受到伤害时，你会获得一层电光充能。

在增幅状态下，护盾可抵挡的伤害显著增加。

perkDetails.name: Knockout
perkDetails.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

items.name: Sunfire Furnace
items.description:
While your Solar Super is charged, ability final blows cure you and give stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, grenade and Shieldburst final blows trigger an ignition. Each stack increases grenade regeneration, class ability regeneration, and Super damage. Upon exiting your Super, all stacks are converted into Super energy.
items.descriptionZh:
你的烈日超能完成充能时，技能最后一击会治愈你并提供日焰熔炉层数。

日焰熔炉生效期间，手雷和盾爆最后一击会触发一次点燃。每层效果都会增加手雷回复、职业技能回复以及超能伤害。超能结束后，所有层数都会转化为超能能量。

items.name: Information
items.description:
• Traveler's Blessings have a chance to be awarded from most chests in the Traveler's Pale Heart. This includes Cyst chests, Lost Sector chests, Overthrow Level 2 and Level 3 encounter chests, Pathfinder Field Assignment chests, and Triage chests.

• Each daily reset, a Lost Sector, Cyst, or Overthrow grant a guaranteed Traveler's Blessing upon completion. Look on the Traveler's Pale Heart map to find out which activity grants a guaranteed blessing!

• Traveler's Blessings awarded from the above sources will always be chosen from the list of expired Traveler's Blessings.

• Once acquired, Traveler's Blessings can be used for 27 hours before expiring.
items.descriptionZh:
• 旅行者苍白之心的大多数宝箱有一定几率奖励旅行者的祝福。具体而言，包括囊肿宝箱、遗失区域宝箱、颠覆等级2和等级3遭遇战宝箱、寻路者外勤任务宝箱、分诊宝箱。

• 每次日常重置后，遗失区域、囊肿或颠覆活动完成时必定奖励一次旅行者的祝福。查看旅行者苍白之心地图，找出必定奖励祝福的活动！

• 上述来源奖励的旅行者的祝福将始终从已过期的旅行者的祝福列表中选取。

• 获得奖励后，旅行者的祝福将在27小时后过期。

Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates class ability energy.

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成职业技能能量。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成近战能量。

items.name: Roast 'Em
items.description:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.
items.descriptionZh:
你的感应飞刀会灼烧爆炸时造成伤害的目标，或在最后一击时点燃目标。

在投掷感应飞刀后，你会在飞刀爆炸前获得更高的近战回复能力。当你用灼烧伤害目标时，获得少量近战能量，点燃最后一击会完全返还近战能量，并可满溢为额外的飞刀充能。

items.description:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.

•  减速目标。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Overload Machine Guns
perkDetails.description:
Shots from Machine Guns you are wielding disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Machine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你使用的机枪射出的子弹可扰乱战斗人员，使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复，并使其疲惫。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间机枪将始终过充。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Piercing Sidearms
perkDetails.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Fusion Rifles
perkDetails.description:
Aiming down sights for a brief period with any Fusion Rifle you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Fusion Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Overload Trace Rifles
perkDetails.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Rocket Launcher
perkDetails.description:
Shortly after you ready or reload a Rocket Launcher, damage from that weapon stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Rocket Launchers are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在你准备或填装火箭发射器之后不久，该武器造成的伤害会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间火箭发射器将始终过充。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This perk will be enabled when you equip a weapon of the appropriate archetype.

perkDetails.descriptionZh:

perkDetails.name: Feed the Void
perkDetails.description:
Defeat a target with a Void ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用虚空技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

enabledRules.failureMessage: Not Yet Unlocked

Ability not yet unlocked.

This ability can be unlocked by speaking with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.

Ability requires meditation.

perkDetails.name: Chaos Accelerant
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Overcharge your grenade, making it deadlier and more effective.

Vortex Grenade: Increases the size, linger duration, and pull of the vortex.

Axion Bolt: Detonates twice and has enhanced seekers.

Scatter Grenade: Submunitions track to nearby targets.

Magnetic Grenade, Spike Grenade, Voidwall Grenade, and Suppressor Grenade: Releases a short-range Void blast. Cooldown is reduced.

Grants an additional grenade charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：对手雷进行过充，使其更加致命有效。

涡流手雷：提升漩涡的大小、持续时间和和拉力。

量子光束：引爆两次，拥有强化追踪弹。

散射手雷：子弹药可追踪附近目标。

磁性手雷、尖刺榴弹、虚空之墙手雷和抑制手雷：释放短程的虚空爆破。冷却时间减少。

提供额外手雷充能。

Ability not yet unlocked.

This ability can be unlocked by speaking with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.

Ability requires meditation.

Use the meditation device near Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar to unlock.

perkDetails.name: Soul Siphon
perkDetails.description:
Ready this aspect by striking a foe with your powered melee ability.

Once readied, press your melee ability to begin siphoning energy from all combatants in front of you, dealing damage and gathering Overshield and class ability energy from each target.

Soul Siphon's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Melee stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用充能近战技能打击敌人来准备此星相。

就绪后，按下近战技能，开始从你面前所有战斗人员身上汲取能量，造成伤害并从每个目标身上获取覆盖护盾和职业技能能量。

灵魂虹吸的伤害会根据近战属性强化收益而调整。

enabledRules.failureMessage: Not Yet Unlocked

tooltipNotifications.displayString:
Ability not yet unlocked.

This ability can be unlocked by speaking with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.

Ability requires meditation.

Use the meditation device near Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar to unlock.

perkDetails.name: Child of the Old Gods
perkDetails.description:
Cast your rift to create a Void Soul. When you damage a target with a weapon, your Void Soul flies to them and drains them, doing damage and weakening them. Combatants affected by the Soul are also briefly suppressed.

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Defeating a target who is being drained by your Void Soul grants class ability energy.

The Void Soul's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放你的裂痕来制造一个虚空灵魂。使用武器对目标造成伤害时，你的虚空之魂会飞向他们并进行汲取，造成伤害并削弱他们。受灵魂影响的战斗人员还会被短暂压制。

目标被汲取时，你将获得手雷和近战能量（如果使用治愈裂痕）或生命值（如果使用强能裂痕）。

击败正被虚空灵魂汲取的目标可提供职业技能能量。

虚空灵魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

items.name: Kismet
items.description:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.

生命值全满时造成最后一击，或长时间脱离战斗后，你的护盾将缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

当你拥有覆盖护盾时，提升武器对战斗人员的精度、稳定性、操控性及伤害，覆盖护盾耗尽后，最后一击会在短时间内提供敏捷加成。

items.name: Silkstrike
items.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
items.descriptionZh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

items.name: Storm's Edge
items.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

perkDetails.name: Collective Action
perkDetails.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

items.name: Slug Rifle
items.description: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.
items.descriptionZh: 此武器可发射爆炸弹头。当使用瞄准镜瞄准时，弹头速度快，弹道笔直。当进行腰际射击时，爆炸规模更大，可对目标施加灼烧效果。

perkDetails.name: Slug Rifle
perkDetails.description: Lobs explosive slugs.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 发射爆炸弹头。

perkDetails.name: Sword Storm Combo
perkDetails.description: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Void Infestation
perkDetails.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

perkDetails.name: Tazer Tag
perkDetails.description: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Sticker Shock
perkDetails.description: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perkDetails.description: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去或射击造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Rupture
perkDetails.description: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成动能武器伤害有几率生成一个动能裂口。以此裂口为目标会造成眩晕战斗人员的伤害性爆炸，克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Sniper's Meditation

perkDetails.description:
Solar ability final blows, Hammer of Sol impacts, and defeating scorched targets creates Sunspots. Your abilities regenerate faster, and your Super drains more slowly while standing in a Sunspot.

Sunspots apply scorch and deal damage to targets inside. Entering a Sunspot applies restoration.

perkDetails.name: Consecration
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可向前发射一波烈日能量，跃向空中的同时对前方目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战技能可猛击地面，生成第二波更大的烈日伤害能量。如果能量波击中灼烧目标，则会将其点燃。

perkDetails.name: Shieldburst
perkDetails.description:
Enhances your equipped barricade with [Solar] Solar capabilities.

Towering Barricade: Your barricade slides forward across the ground before stopping, allowing you to advance in safety.

Rally Barricade: Standing behind your barricade grants scorching rounds to your allies' Solar and Kinetic weapons.

While your barricade is deployed, activate your class ability again to remotely detonate it, scorching combatants caught in the detonation. Dealing damage increases the power of the blast.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
为你当前装备的屏障提供烈日能力强化。

巍峨屏障：你的屏障会在地面上向前滑行后再停下，让你能够安全推进。

集结屏障：站在你的屏障后时，为盟友的烈日和动能武器提供灼烧弹。

在你的屏障部署期间，再次激活职业技能会远程引爆它，灼烧爆炸范围内的战斗人员。造成伤害会提升爆炸威力。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Crackshot
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to fire up to three scorching shots at combatants you've marked. Aim at targets to mark them.

Landing all three shots cures you.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能来向你标记的战斗人员发射至多三发灼烧射击。瞄准目标来标记他们。

三发全中会治愈你。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Knock 'Em Down
perkDetails.description:
Your Solar Supers are enhanced. Deadshot Golden Gun has damage resistance, Marksman Golden Gun has increased duration, and Blade Barrage launches more projectiles.

While radiant, final blows with your equipped Throwing Knife fully refund your melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的烈日超能已得到强化。死亡射击黄金枪获得伤害抗性，神枪手黄金枪持续时间延长，利刃弹幕可发射更多射弹。

拥有焕光效果时，使用已装备的投掷飞刀造成最后一击可完全补偿近战能量。

perkDetails.name: On Your Mark
perkDetails.description:
Activating your class ability or landing precision hits grants you and nearby allies increased reload speed and Weapons stat for a short duration. Stacks ten times.

Final blows while at ten stacks cure you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能或造成精准命中可让你和附近盟友在短时间内提升填装速度和武器属性。可叠加十次。

达到十层时造成最后一击将治愈你。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

items.name: Storm's Edge
items.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

急冻手雷：追踪弹在冻结目标后将会复制，并在引爆时生成冰影水晶。

碎裂手雷：引爆时产生额外碎片射弹。用此手雷命中被冻结的目标会返还部分手雷能量。

items.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空光能圣盾。
哨兵圣盾生效时：
[轻攻击]  ：攻击。
[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.

你和你的盟友处在黎明护罩中时，会获得虚空覆盖护盾并且提升武器伤害，护罩内的目标则会被削弱。

护罩的制造者在护罩中时还会获得近战伤害提升，并且可以拾取并投掷护罩核心，以此重新放置护罩，最多两次。
